_comment: The U3 source fixtures (plan Appendix C, S0), saved on 29 Sep 2026 between 15:42 and 15:47 UTC from the live probe URLs, one request per URL, each host's robots.txt read first, with the product's own identifying User-Agent (worker/feed/http.ts USER_AGENT), sequentially with 1 to 2 s pauses. Shape follows test/fixtures/dogadanja/sources.json; `bytesFetched` is the decoded response size, `bytesSaved` the size of the file in this directory, `sha256` the hash of the saved file. Dates and times inside the pages are as served (Europe/Zagreb local unless a field says otherwise). Every file is saved byte for byte except where its `cut` says otherwise. Extra requests beyond the fixtures: the robots.txt of nine hosts; kultura.zagreb.hr/ (home, read for the terms link), /pravila-koristenja; hak.hr/hak/uvjeti-koristenja; hep.hr/ods/impressum/588; zagrebarena.hr default.aspx?id=18&godina=2026 and default.aspx?id=3175 (one detail page); gnkdinamo.hr/hr/sitemap.xml. None of these is saved except through the quoted lines.

fixtures.cut: First 150 of the 1000 rows of `events`, in the order served (the server sorts by occurrence_start ascending), every field of every row kept, including `event_description`, `organisation_description`, `contact_mail` and `event_image`. The top-level object has one key, `events`; nothing else is served. Written as compact JSON plus one trailing newline; the bytes are identical to the first 150 rows of the served body (checked). The 150 rows are 72 distinct events (`event_id`) with occurrence_start from 2026-09-29T00:00:00 to 2026-10-03T00:00:00 (Zagreb local, no zone suffix).
fixtures.totalRowsNote: The whole response has exactly 1000 rows, which is the server's cap: 216 distinct event_id, occurrence_start from 2026-09-29T00:00:00 to 2026-12-05T11:15:00. The module must treat 1000 as coverage.limited.
fixtures.robotsTxt: https://kultura.zagreb.hr/robots.txt (200, read 2026-09-29T15:42:33Z): 'User-Agent: *', 'Allow: /', 'Disallow: /api/', 'Disallow: /_next/', 'Disallow: /admin/', 'Disallow: /private/'. The path /api/chatbot/events falls under 'Disallow: /api/'; it is read here and by the module under the owner's ruling O-70 (City domain, City programme, terms allow reuse with attribution and a link; one read per 30 minutes, identified by the User-Agent).
fixtures.terms: https://kultura.zagreb.hr/pravila-koristenja (200, read 2026-09-29T15:46:18Z): 'Ponovna upotreba podataka dopuštena je uz obvezno navođenje izvora s poveznicom na Guru za kulturu.' The same page: 'Na stranici se objavljuju samo programi sufinancirani kroz Proračun Grada Zagreba.'
fixtures.notes: Fields per row (40): address_id, address_name, address_text, age, category, contact_mail, dp_entrance, dp_toilete, event_approved, event_created_at, event_description, event_id, event_image, event_name, event_publish, favorite, is_active, is_today, is_tomorrow, is_weekend, kids, latitude, longitude, main_address, neighbourhood, occurrence_created_at, occurrence_end, occurrence_id, occurrence_price, occurrence_slug, occurrence_start, organisation_approved, organisation_description, organisation_id, organisation_id_org, organisation_image, organisation_name, organisation_slug, parking, pets, type. Every row has latitude and longitude. There is no per-event slug: the only slug is `occurrence_slug` (e.g. 'dragutin-domjanic-stoljece-i-pol-29-09-2026-02-00'), so a module that builds the link https://kultura.zagreb.hr/dogadanja/<slug> must confirm the link form. Exhibitions run 00:00 to 23:59 on each day of their window (one row per day). `contact_mail` carries organisation contact addresses, some of them named people at their institutions; they are unused by the plan (see the report, open issues). Response headers: content-type application/json, server Vercel, cache-control public, max-age=0, must-revalidate.

A second request for https://gnkdinamo.hr/hr/sitemap.xml at 2026-09-29T15:43:55Z got the same 403 challenge (5,509 bytes). Only robots.txt passes. No browser User-Agent was spoofed and no challenge was attempted: a Worker fetch with the product's identifying User-Agent would get this page, so a Dinamo sub-fetcher cannot work against gnkdinamo.hr. The fixture is kept so U3's parser or module test can pin the failure mode (a 403 whose body is a Cloudflare challenge must read as 'down', never as zero fixtures).

fixtures.cut: Kept: the document head (everything before the first `<grad`: the XML declaration `<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>`, `<sedamdana>`, `<izmjena run="06">Zadnja izmjena 29.09.2026. u 11:22.</izmjena>`) and the two consecutive blocks for ZAGREB-GRIČ and ZAGREB-MAKSIMIR, joined by one newline, closed with `</sedamdana>` (no trailing newline, as served). Dropped: the other 321 `<grad>` blocks (323 in the full document). Block delimiters, the same slicing the module will use: a block starts at the exact text `\t<grad ime="ZAGREB-GRIČ" code="ZAGREB-GRIČ">` and ends at the next `</grad>` (blocks do not nest; indentation is one tab for `<grad>`, two for `<dan>`, three for the fields), so `indexOf(start)` and `indexOf('</grad>', start)` slice one station without parsing the 6.9 MB. Station names appear as both `ime` and `code`, upper case, diacritics as UTF-8.

Each station has 107 `<dan>` steps: leadtime 1 to 84 hourly, 84 to 138 every 3 h, 138 to 168 every 6 h; first step datum 29.09.2026. sat 09, last 06.10.2026. sat 08. `sat` is the Europe/Zagreb local hour (leadtime 1 of run 06 is 07 UTC = sat 09). Per step: t_2m, simbol, vjetar, oborina (mm), vjerojatnost (%). This slice is DRY: max oborina 0.0 and max vjerojatnost 10 at both stations, temperature 9.0 to 24.5. Symbols in the slice: 1, 1n, 2, 2n, 3; in the whole document also 4, 3n, 4n, 6, 6n, 7, 7n, 8, 8n, 9, 9n, 11, 11n, 12, 12n, 26 (the 'n' suffix is night). A rain test needs a doctored copy of this slice (or a fresh wet-day sample); none is provided here.

Article 10 (forbidden): 'automatizirano preuzimati, indeksirati ili prikupljati sadržaje uporabom robota, programskih skripti, alata za scraping ili drugih automatiziranih sredstava, osim uz prethodno pisano odobrenje HAK-a'. Article 9: without written consent no commercial use, and no passing on 'trećim osobama putem podatkovnog sučelja, informacijskog sustava, aplikacije'; 'Uvjeti komercijalnog korištenja, distribucije ili strojne razmjene podataka uređuju se pisanim sporazumom s Hrvatskim autoklubom.' Articles 8 and 10 pull in different directions for a scripted fetch of a limited selection; the plan's 'ready (yellow)' verdict for HAK rests on article 8 alone.
